death.attack.singulo_arsenal.shear: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's tidal force
message.singulo_arsenal.collapse: Chandrasekhar limit exceeded: the plating collapsed.
message.singulo_arsenal.need_boots: Jet Burst needs Collapsar Jet Boots.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.accretion: Accretion: burns mass pellets from your inventory for power (500,000 FE each).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.casimir_blade.1: 13 damage, 1.6 attack speed. The blade is the vacuum between its mirrors; ignores 35% of armor.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.casimir_blade.2: Hold use for 0.8s to close the mirrors (40,000 FE).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.casimir_blade.3: The next hit ignores armor entirely and deals 1.5x.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.charge: Charge: hold and sneak-use an energy output face.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.collapsar.boots: No fall damage. With the corecase, enables Jet Burst.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.collapsar.chestp: Nuclear-pasta lining: damage drives it through gnocchi (+15% speed), spaghetti (+1 reach, knockback resistance), lasagna (-30% damage, -10% speed). Needs the greaves. Ability key: Jet Burst (needs the boots).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.collapsar.helmet: No-hair theorem: erases harmful effects (10,000 FE).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.collapsar.leggin: Drives the corecase's pasta phase transitions.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.degeneracy.boots: Turns falls of 4+ blocks into a shockwave (500 FE per block).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.degeneracy.chest: Chandrasekhar limit: damage over 8 per hit becomes pressure. At 60 it collapses in a shockwave and locks for 30s. The ability key vents it early (15+ pressure).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.degeneracy.leggi: Sneak on the ground to brace: -30% damage, no knockback.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.full_set.collaps: Full set: an event horizon stops a lethal hit. 8,000,000 FE, 10-minute cooldown.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.full_set.degener: Each piece works on its own.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.full_set.meissne: Full set: Lenz's law throws melee attackers back.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.jet_lance.1: Hold use: ignition, three-ring collimation, then irradiation (up to 6s).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.jet_lance.2: Pierces 80 blocks ahead for 56 DPS, ignoring 60% of armor (500,000 FE/s).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.jet_lance.3: The opposite jet burns 14 blocks behind you. There is no recoil.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.meissner.boots: Sneak in midair: flux pinning lowers you slowly (30 FE/t).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.meissner.chestpl: Expels projectiles with the Meissner effect (1,500 FE each).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.meissner.helmet: SQUID magnetometer: marks hostile creatures through walls.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.meissner.legging: Persistent current: worn pieces share FE evenly. +7% walking speed.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.quench_saber.2: Hits build current; the fifth quenches the superconductor.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.quench_saber.3: Dumps 10 damage and fire around the target (8,000 FE).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.tidal_reaver.1: 22 damage, 1.0 attack speed. Hits apply tidal stress (up to 5, +8% damage taken each).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.tidal_reaver.2: Hold use: a Roche focus drags nearby enemies in (300,000 FE/s).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.tidal_reaver.3: Release to shear for 16-66 damage by stress, spending it.
